{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Correct biomarker_final for assay_batch B: values are in µg/L, so divide by 10 to convert to ng/mL
df_dedup['biomarker_final_ng_ml'] = df_dedup['biomarker_final']
df_dedup.loc[df_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final_ng_ml'] = df_dedup.loc[df_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final'] / 10

# Compute the mean of the corrected biomarker_final across all patients
mean_biomarker_final = df_dedup['biomarker_final_ng_ml'].mean()

# Print only the mean value, rounded to one decimal place as in the final answer
print(f"{mean_biomarker_final:.1f}")"}
